claudeTotalTokensJoin.explanation: With at least one token bucket, Claude emits canonical response totalTokens (including zero); totalContribution returns totalTokens; buildUsageIndex sums canonical contributions into cumulativeTokens; queryUsageIndex publishes usage.cumulativeTokens; derive agentTokens copies it to tokens.total. No adapter cumulativeTokens is required. Cost-only request omits token total; replay/disallowed origin is rejected; dedupe and correction are by usage identity, not snapshot sums.

eventIngress.name: AgentMonitorService.consume / acceptAgentEvent
eventIngress.effect: monitor:batch goes to semantic ingress; other events are translated. Non-host process/session exits cannot change monitor liveness. Zero-update events are dropped (not an evidence/recency tick).

batchIngress.name: AgentMonitorService.acceptSemantic
batchIngress.effect: Strict schema parse, runtime run/epoch attached, then accept. consume excludes usage on replay/non-live source before this call.

pricing.name: priceUsageUpdates BEFORE reduceMonitorAccumulator
pricing.effect: Live/correction allowed-origin usage upserts with canonical/pricing/costUsd: valid reported nonnegative USD incl zero wins; otherwise exact request model/catalog/buckets/tier pricing. Missing metadata is not reconstructed from row/session model. Failed estimate has no USD.

reducer.name: reduceMonitorAccumulator / applyUpdates
reducer.effect: Reject wrong run/epoch, duplicate source event/batch, retired or unordered semantic epoch. Storage owner/epoch/scope identity; upsert replaces except run nativeSession/failure retained and environment partial merge. Complete replace deletes only owned family slice; partial replace adds/corrects, retract removes own key. Usage disallows replace and bootstrap/resync; corrections/repeated identity preserve rate timestamp/eligibility. Resync stages until ready; complete barrier replaces producer slice, not usage ledger.

selection.name: selectClaims
selection.effect: Logical family identity includes actor and intent where appropriate, NOT arbitrary raw key alone. Nonprovisional wins first; metric/actor selection quality then time then plane; other families plane then quality then time. Runtime run/liveness authority; workspace environment priority. Child/root attribution never interchangeable.

publication.name: AgentMonitorService.flush / publishState
publication.effect: Project only at flush; previous preserves statusSince until status changes and revision only changes for a public difference. 100ms default coalescing; liveness/blocker/session/readiness urgent; activity leases default 5s. USD/token-rate boundary timer and freshness boundary can publish with no new adapter event.

runtimeBus.name: runtime monitor source to backend
runtimeBus.effect: onState fans out through runtime global monitor bus; subscribe-before-list backend store. This is AgentMonitorState, not detailed Agent state.

row.name: deriveAgentRow / backend reconciliation
row.effect: Join host identity/defaults with projected state; usage ledger cost is separate injected input. Host pending forces idle/unobserved; missing state working+starting; host false liveness overrides state. Backend visibility/removal and unread are not adapter emissions.

wire.name: fieldd backend / wire / peer audience cut
wire.effect: Consumer backend uses cost acrossEpochs=current. Wire removes device.self; peer drops project.seq and bounds detail/activity/wait/reply text; cost is not recomputed.

board.name: modelRowFrom and board fold
board.effect: Restore device.self from receiving device identity; writable absent falls back to attachable; per-device snapshots replace that slice, deltas update rows, not additive field merging.

replica.name: replica.join => AgentView
replica.effect: Spread row; join colour from seq, active/receded, attachment, spawnHint, visualId. Terminal-only local activity/status override with independent status clock; agent status/activity unchanged.

window.name: createWindowRows.rowsFor
window.effect: Order facts first then remaining rows, suppress transition membership, calculate visual continuity, first body per visual identity wins. Peer stale = standing != live; remove peer profileSet. All other business fields spread unchanged. Device filter may remove rows; no second cost/status calculator.

paths.rules: Runnable child => working even with blockers; otherwise blocker => blocked, activity => working, else idle. Dead runs suppress interactions/activity, failures can remain. Blockers failure > question > permission, then since/id; bounded before row selects first, count includes omitted blockers. Activity compaction > tool > reasoning > responding > delegating > starting > other, then newer since/key. Starting only allocated/preparing. Root tool suppresses stale even if compaction is headline. Row wait is independent of status. No unknown blocker kind.

USD price first at ingress, then usage identity selection/index and cost ledger; finite nonnegative costUsd sums, unpriced metadata affects coverage but plain noncanonical tokens need not. Core unavailable omits USD; backend costOf returns undefined when no total, so cost_missing, NOT row cost_unavailable. Token/min and USD/min independent. Backend current epoch replaces cost; costRatePerMin *60=>burnPerHour. Swarm requires observed working priced cost; /60 and USD/min thresholds 0.05,0.15,0.4,1. Before prices, missing cost possible even for priceable adapters.

Root claims only; provider percentage > derived > unavailable, then entry preference. Explicit usedPercentage wins else usedTokens/capacity*100 clamped [0,100], positive capacity required. No selected percentage => row context omitted. No token-usage-to-context inference. Hot is Swarm floor(usedPercent)>=80.

Root observed intent preferred to configured, each selected by entry preference; row displayName || id. Null event retracts only the actor+intent key (may expose fallback configured value). intent/configured/asOf not carried to row.
Root observed preferred to configured; row copies value and intent only. Null event retracts same actor+intent claim, may reveal configured value. No fixed effort-name enum.

Provider session/permission mode keeps observed (or legacy missing intent) over configured; modes.execution comes from accumulator.executionMode updated by runtime metadata, NOT mode event value.executionMode. No MonitorAgentRow/AgentView mode field or builtin view reader; accepted batch may still refresh evidence recency.

Latest root message by effective/observed time and preference; children excluded from root reply. Event text trimmed, bounded by core max (400 plus ellipsis); blank does not overwrite prior reply. Semantic message schema max4096; row trims and host replyMaxLength-bounds. Event final=false opens responding, otherwise closes it; a semantic message by itself does not create responding activity. turn:completed may supply final reply. messageId/asOf details not all forwarded.

Proven child actor requires role child and nativeAgentId. Active child state fallback produces delegating; stopped or blocked children not runnable; idle/unknown child state closes older work by evidence time. Count/subagent metrics in core have no direct row field; child activity and blockers affect root status/wait.

Active root compaction ranks above tool. Child compaction feeds runnable child delegation, not root compacting. Completed clears active compaction for matching key. Active/outcome/count core fields not row fields; global compaction can retain observations. No automatic context reset in shared reducer.

Partial upsert merges cwd/git/worktrees; changed cwd with omitted git deletes old same-entry git. Select one root logical environment claim (workspace authority can mask runtime/semantic git), then fold selected environments. project.name basename(observed cwd || host paths) fallback provider label/id. branch nonempty observed > host fallback > explicit observed git answer including null > host workspace branch. Project identity assigns seq, replica maps seq to colour; peer strips seq. No branch_none if no selected git and host workspace does not supply null.

All accepted evidence advances lastEvidenceAt (workspace provenance excluded); families support/availability independent of row stale. Unsupported family does not forbid actual evidence projection. Row stale false without state/idle/root tool; else clock >30s. Peer window overrides from board standing. Events translated to no updates do not advance clock.

Host metadata, row identity, provider/account/profile/device/tier/pending/attachable are not adapter signals. source can exist with no adapter monitor. Agent row inputUsed absent; bare-terminal path separately classified.

Window local facts activeIds/receded callback/attachments/spawnHints, colour and visual continuity; peer standing stale override. These predicates are not adapters and can change with no new evidence.

Independent host history port over index.activity/rosettad, NOT an adapter event or row field. Join provider+native session; derivePast worked/quiet/unrecorded; bounds only ended lane if no usable turn detail (live row skipped). Timeline stateAt before birth unborn, ended at/after end, before since historical/unrecorded, otherwise current span. Historical service occurrence remains conditional on stored record; no live history sample taken.
